name: app-portfolio-story-set-orange-black-mockup-fan
title: Fanned phone mockups showing an orange/black portfolio story set
whatItIs: Five phone mockups fanned out on a grey background, each displaying a different story screen (podcast, live talks, Q&A, branding, work-with-us) from one cohesive orange-and-black portfolio brand.
whatItMeans: A fanned multi-device arrangement lets a designer showcase a full story sequence at once, giving viewers the sense of flipping through a real Instagram highlight reel.
techniques: fan multiple device mockups at slight angles to show a sequence as one composition
hold a strict two-color (orange/black) system across every screen for instant brand recognition
mix full-bleed photography screens with pure typographic screens for pacing
bestFor: case study presentation of a social system

vocabulary.definition: a presentation arrangement showing multiple screens on angled, overlapping device frames
